comment: A dagger: the small end of the melee range, where the wound model's heft factor falls BELOW the arming sword instead of above it. Regenerate with scripts/gen_shortblade_items.py — the edge and hilt blocks are emitted from the same constants that build the mesh, so the hitbox cannot drift from the art. There is deliberately no "heft" key: heft is DERIVED from this file's own voxel volume (item.h ItemDef::heftVolume), so re-authoring the blade re-weighs it in the same edit.
name: dagger
